newsitem.title: RUSSIA: One killed, three injured in south Russia fighting.
newsitem.headline: One killed, three injured in south Russia fighting.

text.p: At least one person was killed and three injured by gunfire when about 1,000 people from two rival Moslem religious groups started fighting in Russia's southern Dagestan region, police said on Tuesday.
The fighting began on Monday night in a village in the North Causasus region bordering the breakaway republic of Chechnya , said a police spokesman in the Dagestan capital Makhachkala .
The rival groups were still in the centre of the village on Tuesday morning and regional police officials were sending in reinforcements in an attempt to quell the violence.
"The situation has worsened in the region,. Unfortunately, it happens quite often in our republic," the spokesman said.
Dagestan, a complex region of some 30 different ethnic groups, has been troubled occasionally by violence spilling over from Chechnya.

The fighting began just hours after Russian President Boris Yeltsin and Chechen leader Aslan Maskhadov signed a peace accord on Monday, promising an end to 400 years of intermittent conflict between Moscow and independence-minded Chechnya.
